title: 第7章 同化员工同化梦境物品第8章 恢复本相死亡空间的异动
slug: 虚实梦境之主从死后开始
content_zh:
孟天的幻象分身，保洁员在离开经理办公室之后，立即带着虚假的笑容，来到最近的一个公司牛马身边。
“经理叫你！”
“经理…叫我？”
那人呆呆抬头，木木的开口。
“嗯！”
“…好！”
在得到确定之后，那人缓缓的站起身，脸上浮现一抹僵硬的忐忑，慢慢走向经理办公室。
李笑笑以及其余人，又皆是同情的看向他。
不知道经理，又要怎么骂他了。
而孟天的分身保洁员，则是开始按照灌输的意识本能，机械的拖地。
从东到西，从南到北，走廊过道，一遍又一遍。
…………
“经理，你叫我！”
那为公司牛马进入办公室，来到孟天面前的办公桌前方站立。
“嗯，过来！”
孟天招招手，让那人靠近。
“是！”
那人靠近之后，孟天一把抓住他的手臂。
其身上，同样升起了一股对抗的力量。
不过就在这时，经理办公室竟然泛起一丝波动，将这股对抗压制了小半。

这是…
孟天眼神微闪。
经理对于手下员工的压制？
不过不管是因为什么，这都是对他有利的就是了。
无视了剩下的最后一分轻微抵抗力量，孟天体内力量汹涌而入。
片刻过后，孟天完成同化，将大部分力量收入体内，只余0.1点能量，维持其正常形体。
0.2！
感受体内增加的力量，想着外间的二十多个员工，孟天脸上笑意愈浓。
虽然这样较为繁琐，但一点点的同化吞噬，却能获得更多的力量。
一个员工0.3点能量，二十多个，那就能够获得六七点能量，如果再算上最后的梦主小李，他也许能够一次获得十点能量。
至于如此一来，李笑笑会不会受到伤害…
孟天觉得应该不会。
有着身体生命能量支撑，其所拥有的精神能量，理论上应该远远超过孟天。
content_en:
Meng Tian's phantom clone, the cleaning lady, immediately came to the nearest company cow and horse with a fake smile after leaving the manager's office.
"The manager calls you!"
"Manager...call me?"
The man looked up blankly and spoke numbly.
"Yeah!"
"...Okay!"
After getting the confirmation, the man stood up slowly, with a stiff look of apprehension on his face, and walked slowly to the manager's office.
Li Xiaoxiao and the others all looked at him sympathetically.
I don’t know how the manager is going to scold him.
Meng Tian's clone, the cleaning lady, began to mop the floor mechanically according to the instilled consciousness and instinct.
From east to west, from south to north, corridors and aisles, over and over again.
…………
"Manager, call me!"
The company's bull entered the office and stood in front of the desk in front of Meng Tian.
"Well, come here!"
Meng Tian waved to the man to come closer.
"Yes!"
After the man approached, Meng Tian grabbed his arm.
On him, there was also a force of resistance.
But at this moment, there was a slight fluctuation in the manager's office, which suppressed the confrontation by half.
This is…
Meng Tian's eyes flashed slightly.
Manager's suppression of his employees?
But no matter what the reason is, it's all in his favor.
Ignoring the last remaining slight resistance, the power surged into Meng Tian's body.
After a while, Meng Tian completed the assimilation and absorbed most of the power into his body, leaving only 0.1 points of energy to maintain his normal form.
0.2!
Feeling the increased strength in his body and thinking about the more than 20 employees outside, the smile on Meng Tian's face grew stronger.
Although this is more cumbersome, a little bit of assimilation and devouring can gain more power.
If an employee has 0.3 energy points and more than 20, he can obtain six or seven energy points. If you include the last dream owner Xiao Li, he may be able to obtain ten energy points at a time.
As for whether Li Xiaoxiao will be harmed...
Meng Tian thinks not.
With the support of physical life energy, the spiritual energy it possesses should theoretically far exceed that of Meng Tian.
